_comment: Copy this file to whatsapp-notifier-projects.json (gitignored) and fill in your own values. Used by scripts/install-calendar-assistant-launchd-macos.sh — see README for the full explanation of what this does and the tools/permissions it requires.
_statusEmailTo_comment: Optional. If set, each project with calendar-worthy news gets one status email sent here, subject '[tag] Status - YYYYMMDD'. Leave empty to disable email entirely.
_slackChannelId_comment: Optional. Slack channel ID (not the #name) to post one combined summary to per run. Leave empty to disable Slack entirely.
_crossPostingNotes_comment: Optional free text describing any rule for when one event should be created on more than one calendar (e.g. shared custody, a shared household calendar plus a personal one). Leave empty if you don't need this.

projects.description: Household scheduling, kids' activities, appointments mentioned in these chats

_projects_comment: One entry per calendar/bucket. 'tag' becomes the email subject tag and the internal label the assistant uses to route each message — keep it short, no spaces needed but fine either way. 'chats' are WhatsApp JIDs (group JIDs end in @g.us, direct chats in @s.whatsapp.net) — find them with list_chats via the whatsapp MCP server. A chat can only belong to one project. Add as many project objects as you have calendars/buckets.
